_comment: Reviewed PAMUUC SEO copy, 17 September 2026. pages contains explicit titles and descriptions for all 56 current routes and takes precedence over templates. Review metadata for each new route before publication. Product descriptions in the fallback builder still come from catalogue copy; the product description template is reserved. Keep route IDs and placeholders intact.
